handle_generation.name: the sidecar-driven tool loop: reported turns persist before the answer
handle_generation.note: the loop reports an assistant turn, calls a tool, and the daemon runs it. The reported turns land in the conversation ahead of the response, and the same turns are appended to the cached last_request. The tool itself fails (nothing wires activity stats in this harness), which is the point of a second case: a failed tool is a result the model is told about, not an abandoned turn
